```{r Formula to calculate Levenshtein distance }
##returns a list with
#[1]the normalized average Levenshtein distance
#[2]mapping of the user Items to the stimuli Items
calculate_levdist <- function(stimCode, userCode)
{
 
  mapping = array(dim = length(stimCode))
  matchedStimuli = array(0, dim = length(stimCode))
  matchedUserCode = array(0, dim = length(userCode))
  
  final_LDs = array(dim = length(stimCode))
  normalfinal_LDs = array(dim = length(stimCode))
  skip_list =list()
  
  compare_temp = array(dim = length(stimCode)) # array for inner loop
  
  #for each line in the java code
  for(i in seq_along(stimCode))
  {
    compare_temp[] <- 0
    # for each line in the user code
    for(j in seq_along(userCode))
    {
        # compare the line of java code to the user line and store in array using LD 
        #(smallest number means more similar)
        compare_temp[j] = stringdist(stimCode[i], userCode[j], method = "lv")
    }
    #the user code line with the smallest LD
  
    #print("compare_temp")  
    #print(compare_temp)
      
      smallestIndexes = which(compare_temp == min(compare_temp))
     # print("smallestIndexes")
      #print(smallestIndexes)
      
      for(k in seq_along(smallestIndexes))
      {
        #print("smallestIndexes[k]")
        #print(smallestIndexes[k]) 
        #print("skip_list")
        #print(skip_list)
        
        #print("k")
        #print(k)
        if(smallestIndexes[k] %in% skip_list )
        {
          next
        }
        else
        {
          smallestIndex = smallestIndexes[k]
          print("smallestIndex final")
          print(smallestIndex)
          break
        }
      }
      
    
      mapping[i] = smallestIndex #have an issue here where we still are using first instance
      final_LDs[smallestIndex] = compare_temp[smallestIndex]
      max_len <- pmax(nchar(stimCode[i]), nchar(userCode[j]))
      normalfinal_LDs[smallestIndex] = final_LDs[smallestIndex] / max_len  
      
      matchedStimuli[i] = 1
      skip_list = append(skip_list, smallestIndex)
      
      smallestIndex= 0
      
   
  }
   print("mapping")
   print(mapping)
   print("final_LDs")
   print(final_LDs)
   print("normalfinal_LDs")
   print(normalfinal_LDs)
   print(matchedStimuli)
   print(matchedUserCode)
  
   

   
  missinglines = sum(matchedStimuli == 0 )
  extralines = sum(matchedUserCode == 0 )
  
  print(missinglines)
  print(extralines)
  
  errorlines = sum(extralines)
  
  if(errorlines > 0)
  {
    normalfinal_LDs = c(normalfinal_LDs, rep(1, errorlines)) 
  }
  #calculate the LD average
  
  LDAvg = mean(normalfinal_LDs)
  print("LDAvg")
  print(LDAvg)
  
  output = list(LDAvg, mapping)
  print("output")
  print(output)

  return(output) 
}



```

mckData$X1_lev = NA
mckData$X1_mapping = NA
mckData$X2_sfr = NA
mckData$X2_total_acc = NA

mckData$X2_lev = NA
mckData$X2_mapping = NA
mckData$X1_sfr = NA
mckData$X1_total_acc = NA

mckData$X3_lev = NA
mckData$X3_mapping = NA
mckData$X3_sfr = NA
mckData$X3_total_acc = NA


mckData$X4_lev = NA
mckData$X4_mapping = NA
mckData$X4_sfr = NA
mckData$X4_total_acc = NA

mckData$X5_lev = NA
mckData$X5_mapping = NA
mckData$X5_sfr = NA
mckData$X5_total_acc = NA

for(i in 1:length(mckData$X1_code.recall.control)) 
{
  print("loop number:")
  print(i)
  if(mckData$X1_code.recall.control[i] != "" &&  !is.na(mckData$X1_code.recall.control[i]))
  {
    print("not empty!")
    #extract into a vector
    userCode = mckData[ i, "X1_code.recall.control"]
    parts <- strsplit(userCode, split = "\n")
    userCodeVec = unlist(parts)
    
    if(mckData$LangChoice[i] == "Java"){
      
      lev_dat = calculate_levdist(stimCode = javaCode, userCode = userCodeVec)
      mckData$X1_lev[i] = lev_dat[[1]]
      mckData$X1_mapping[i] = list(lev_dat[2])
    }
    else if(mckData$LangChoice[i] == "Python"){
      lev_dat = calculate_levdist(stimCode = pythonCode, userCode = userCodeVec)
      mckData$X1_lev[i] = lev_dat[[1]]
      mckData$X1_mapping[i] = list(lev_dat[2])
    }
    else if(mckData$LangChoice[i] == "C++"){
      lev_dat = calculate_levdist(stimCode = cCode, userCode = userCodeVec)
      mckData$X1_lev[i] = lev_dat[[1]]
      mckData$X1_mapping[i] = list(lev_dat[2])
    }
    else
    {
      print("Error, no language choice detected")
    }
    
  }
}
